Only Epiphaneia (Summer Jersey) displayed
Looking down
*Intent is not to show facial expression; slightly turned away is also fine
→ Walks away afterward

I was at a loss for words. She had genuinely challenged a superior rival with full intent to win, and suffered a crushing defeat.
Yet even now, she hasn't lost an ounce of confidence—not in the slightest.

Has she already accepted the defeat and processed it? Her nonchalance
surprised me... but if so, we should be able to discuss the reasons for her loss.

It does change! When you move forward, the scenery changes!
If you just keep charging ahead, you can even change the world!

Considering how brimming with confidence she had been, this loss
must have been a huge shock. Or perhaps she's bitterly frustrated...

No need for that, I just have to win next time!
The Voice of Destiny will definitely say so too!

Running wild——charging recklessly will not bring victory.
Not just against me... but against everything.

——...Haa... haa...!
...I get it, if I dig in harder like Kris S does...——

Her sharp gaze pierces right through me. She probably thinks I'm trying to step down as trainer
just because she lost... but that's not the real reason.
Yep! What is it?!

...I thought she was simply being dragged around by mere intuition disguised as the Voice of Destiny.
And that if the results proved her wrong, I could talk sense into her.

I'm gonna win. I'll definitely win!
So this time, I just happened to lose, that's all.

If I can guide her and lead her to victory over Symboli Kris S by the day of the match—
only then will I truly be worthy of being her trainer.

I was bewildered at first. But Epi gave her all trying to keep up with my guidance...
and she hung on tenaciously against Kris S, too.

............She cannot win.
Are you... seeking an excuse?

Her voice is conviction itself. She genuinely believes in herself.
That unwavering confidence that she is absolutely right—it never falters.

She lost. Having sprinted full throttle without pacing herself at all,
she ran out of stamina... and was overtaken in an instant—a total defeat.

Nothing is impossible for someone loved by destiny!
Tomorrow, I'll be—even stronger than today!!
...What?

Understood. One month from now.
——Surpass me, if you can.

If so, then just a little longer. If only for a little while—
won't you please give Epi some thought?

Even so... precisely because Epi is like that, I suppose we both
want to witness her future. ...Look over there.

And now... you have appeared.
——You, whom she called destiny itself...

Trainer.
...Aren't you going to go after Epi?

...Oh! I can hear the Voice of Destiny!
Here I gooo!
It just wasn't the time, that's all!

Haa... haa...
...Tch.

It cannot be one-sided. Trainer, you must have felt something too,
which is why you are standing here, right? ...Even now.

Oh dear... Once Epi sets her mind on something, she charges straight ahead...
I was constantly being dragged along by her pace, too.

Still, one day she will run into a wall she cannot break. What she will need then
is not fellow competitors like us... but a guide who can rein in that blazing fire.

Epiphaneia was training alongside Symboli Kris S, whom she had just lost to.
...Or rather—

Kris S through her actions, and myself through careful words...
together, we have been guiding Epi. ——Drawn by her destiny.

Never breaking once... always believing in herself and pushing forward.
With that tremendous momentum, she breaks through every barrier in her path...

If I just keep letting her drag me along, her talent will never fully bloom.
If I can't properly guide her—I should step down as her trainer right now.

Before I knew it, the sun was sinking low. Up until now, I'd only ever seen
her positive side... but what could she be feeling right at this moment?

What I feel from her... is "gravitational pull." Drawn in by her potential,
captivated by her energy... before I know it, I'm willingly swept along in her wake.

Back when I was reaching out to pre-debut girls to learn how to guide others...
Epi was the one who volunteered. ——Saying she "felt destiny."

—What I feel from Epiphaneia. I don't know if it's the "destiny"
she talks about. But... it is definitely, undeniably there.

I didn't want to disturb you, so I refrained from saying anything...
but I've been secretly watching over the two of you.
